snippet.title: Crownbreakers - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Crownbreakers here:  
https://www.crownbreakersgame.com/steam

Crownbreakers is a fast-paced card game that combines turn-based tactics with deck-building mechanics in one snappy package. Free the magical city from the insatiable capitalists that squeeze its souls to grow ever richer.

More info: http://www.crownbreakersgame.com
Sharkbomb Studios: http://www.sharkbombs.com
